ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Anlon Healthcare Limited has announced a Board meeting on October 13, 2026, to deliberate significant business expansion plans in India and/or overseas. A primary agenda item is the raising of funds to finance these initiatives, potentially through equity, debt, or hybrid instruments, which will have a material impact on the company's capital structure and future financial performance. While no immediate red flags are evident in this preliminary notice, investors should monitor the specifics of the financing strategy, as it will determine potential shareholder dilution or increased leverage.
